fix: decode data_base64 as Uint8Array instead of Uint32Array (#662)

The CloudEvent
constructor, MQTT and Kafka structured mode already decode through
base64AsBinary() into a Uint8Array; the HTTP structured path now does
the same. The Kafka structured round-trip test is re-enabled.

Also added myself to the contributors list.

Fixes #643
Supersedes #644
